title: Bubble & Crash
briefing: Pebble Games is in a hype bubble and Orchard Foods is quietly climbing. Steady Stella risks only a little on each trade. Can you beat her without getting caught in the crash?
objective: Size small in a bubble, exit when it cracks, and let steady compounding work.
debrief: Hype posts on days 3 and 8 sent Pebble Games soaring far above its average. The crack came on day 15, when the studio said the viral demo was a prototype, and the bubble deflated over the following week. Orchard Foods rose slowly throughout. A disciplined player kept the bubble position small, left on the crack and kept most of the money in the steady stock.
